propositions: Attribute-form wrapper calls (e.g., core._git(...), self._git(...)) are correctly detected by the existing ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name, but this behavior is undocumented and untested.
All 8 existing R2 tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py exercise only the bare ast.Name form, leaving attribute-form detection coverage implicit and vulnerable to future refactoring.
_ref_lock_push.py fires no alerts because its wrapper call passes 'push', which is not in MUTATION_VERBS, not because attribute calls escape detection.

The existing ast.Attribute branch must be pinned with four new tests: mutation verb detection, receiver-shape independence, fail-closed opaque-argv forwarding, and marker silencing on attribute forms.
Module docstring must be updated to explicitly state that wrapper name matching applies to attributes regardless of receiver shape, reflecting the already-correct but implicit behavior.
